behavior_evaluation.limits: No fresh agent comparison, native game playback, audio/device test or human playtest. Authored synthetic cases are not held-out evidence.

markdown_file_targets.limits: File existence only; no external URL or Markdown anchor-rendering audit.

static_checks.input_judge_case_ids: 12 unique matching IDs; behavior NOT RUN

package_scope: Only skills/kill-game-slop is installed; evals and judge keys remain outside runtime.

document_review.method: Maintaining agent review; no independent evaluator
checks: English/Korean new criteria, example scope and evidence limits agree
Moving attacks and intentional abstraction are not automatic defects
Cancelled action and independently released projectile lifetimes differ
Visible symptom, intended contract and cause are recorded separately
Existing implementation does not override established intent
Old comparison and fixture results remain historical
document_review.limits: Editorial consistency review, not empirical instruction-following validation.
